{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Big Sandy Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Langley, Kentucky to Broad Run Lateral interconnect, Carter County, Kentucky.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/ferc-gives-go-ahead-for-equitrans-big-sandy-pipe-project/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Big Sandy Pipeline LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895728/000089572825000006/eiex211subsidiariesofthere.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''70 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/ferc-gives-go-ahead-for-equitrans-big-sandy-pipe-project/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''20 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/ferc-gives-go-ahead-for-equitrans-big-sandy-pipe-project/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2008<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2011/june-2011-vol-238-no-6/in-the-news/eqt-sells-big-sandy-pipeline-to-spectra|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
